items.title: Divide by decisions and preserve evidence
items.subject: composition
items.description: Design nested ownership, typed reports and same-candidate integration without transcript sharing.
items.use_when: A problem needs coordinated parts, child reports or dependency-sensitive acceptance.
items.do_not_use_when: Splitting mandatory serial stages into optional peers or granting a Designer recursive design authority.

items.title: A parent consumes admitted results, not child prose
items.subject: composition
items.description: Use the search-strategy boundary as a reference for scoped requests and parent-local judgments.
items.use_when: Defining what a child must collect and what its parent needs for its next choice.
items.do_not_use_when: Assuming current search handoffs already implement refiner recursion, staged calls or conflict reporting.

items.title: Turn an A/B repair cycle into one joint task
items.subject: composition
items.description: Retain cross-revision failures and require both sides of a coupled repair on the same candidate.
items.use_when: Repairs alternate between restoring one requirement and breaking another.
items.do_not_use_when: Diagnosing a cycle from pass/fail labels alone or crediting restoration of an already known state.
